stage_2_story.text_en:
David's great adventure began on a Tuesday morning in London. His destination was the British Museum, and he was feeling very confident — until he wasn't.

He decided to take the subway. He bought a ticket from the machine, which took four attempts because he kept pressing the wrong buttons. He found the platform, but then a kind woman tapped his shoulder and said, 'Love, you're on the wrong platform. This one goes to the airport.' David thanked her and quietly moved away.

On the correct platform, he boarded a train but soon realized he needed a transfer. He got off at the wrong station anyway. He stood on the street, completely lost, and stopped a passerby to ask for directions. The man smiled and pointed left, then right, then left again. David nodded as if he understood everything, then walked in a completely random direction.

Finally, he spotted a taxi. The driver knew exactly the route to the museum. The fare was twelve pounds. David arrived twenty minutes later, slightly confused but very happy. The museum was wonderful. Next time, he decided, he would just take the taxi first.

(c) He could not find the machine

options: (b) To tell him he was on the wrong platform
(c) To warn him about a pickpocket
(d) To offer him a subway map

questions.question: Where did the platform David was standing on actually go?
What did David need to do on the subway to reach his destination?
options: (d) Take a taxi from the station

questions.question: Why did David end up on the street feeling lost?
options: (c) He got off at the wrong station
(d) He forgot to buy a ticket

questions.question: How did David react to the passerby's directions?
options: (b) He asked the man to repeat them
(c) He nodded but then walked in the wrong direction

questions.question: How did David finally reach the museum?
options: (c) He went back to the subway

questions.question: How much was the taxi fare to the museum?
What did David decide at the end of the story?
options: (a) He would never visit London again
(b) He would only use the subway in future
(c) He would take the taxi first next time
